policy: Original printed credits and frozen frame poses. Shared set geometry, stroke trim and shadow fit on 99 calibration printings. Equal weight per material and artist; three fixed crops include the common prefix. The existing light-ink palette is fixed, not selected by a color-insensitive objective. Partial perimeter subtraction preserves 35% of fine-stroke coverage, while the independent shadow retains full weight. The same reserved names were reused during model review; this is not fresh generalization evidence. No per-card typography or pose fit.

notes: All 41 examples inspected at identical canonical sampling, including every calibration material and best/worst repeated validation results.
Partial perimeter removal retains fine copyright strokes better than the full-removal V5 model. Filled ink and independent shadow remove the hollow/embossed appearance.
ARN/ATQ stroke-width diagnostics improve. DRK still has a smaller remaining diagnostic regression and is not declared complete.
No new shade was inferred from color-insensitive metrics; existing light ink palette is fixed.
Material texture differences, scan grain, original glyph nuances and existing per-printing shifts remain visible. No per-card typography overrides or pose changes were added.
Native parity/isolation, unrelated controls and renderer release gates are still required.

limitations: Ten unresolved poses remain excluded from scan scores. Seven DRK land/gold cards retain their previous renderer treatment; three unscored ordinary cards use the shared set default.
DRK reserved stroke-width error rises from 0.1354 to 0.1519; differences remain in scan grain, material textures and glyph detail. Individual regressions remain recorded.
The light-ink pigment is the existing native palette. This pass establishes a better shape and shadow treatment, not a photometric calibration of printed ink.
Gaea’s Touch 77† has a shifted printed text plate and is excluded from fitting but retained in reports.
The historical application whole-card index excludes unverified credits. These regional metrics are not a change to hosted graph policy or a correctness percentage.

fullCardDiagnostic.policy: Exact native full-card reconstruction from 0.4.13 plus the isolated canonical artist footer. Existing application index remains separately reported. Local reviewed-credit aggregation includes only scan-verified original credits, with identical weights and eligibility before/after; it is not the hosted score policy. Frozen frame poses and original inputs, ten unresolved scans excluded. Similarity indices are not correctness percentages. Some fixed stats crops can overlap long artist credits without any P/T glyph change.
